name: save-autosave-mstobj03
purpose: iter-465 save lane: 'Autosave without asking' at the game's own MSTobj03 prompt, PORT FEATURES ON (-Gates SR_PORT_FEATURES=1). Custom MAIN MENU -> NEW GAME -> the level-skip dev tool (plan data/devtools/plans/autosave_at_mstobj03.txt) passes MSTobj01..03 and is DONE before the prompt -> SAVE GAME BEFORE CONTINUING? is answered Save Game by the popup hook, which has already made the HUD picker hidden (PrepSlots) -> FillSlotInfo picks the first empty slot -> the picker's own A -> SaveTask -> the game writes the package -> SAVE SUCCESSFUL answered OK -> slot 0 tracked -> the game goes on. Gates: SR_PORT_FEATURES=1,SR_DEVTOOLS=levelskip,SR_DEVTOOLS_CMDS=<plan>,SR_DEVTOOLS_OUT=<dir>. -TimeoutSeconds 900.

steps.name: plan-done
steps.purpose: the dev tool passed MSTobj01..03 and stopped

steps.name: prompt
steps.purpose: the game's own MSTobj03 prompt reached the hook: k 1

steps.name: saved
steps.purpose: SAVE SUCCESSFUL (k 3) answered OK by the popup hook; the slot tracker learns slot 0

steps.name: observe-after
steps.purpose: the chapter load finishes and the game goes on
